opportunities.title: N-able's Fourth Hotfix in Five Weeks: What 'Patch Cadence' Looks Like When It's Failing
opportunities.why_now: N-able has now shipped four emergency patches for N-central in five weeks while active exploitation continues, a textbook case study in reactive patching.
opportunities.angle: Timeline breakdown of the four hotfixes with a scorecard on what each missed, ending with a 'why your RMM vendor's cadence should scare you' takeaway.

opportunities.title: Your RMM Tool Is Now a Worm: Inside the ScreenConnect VBScript Chain Spreading to Every New Host
opportunities.why_now: Multiple outlets confirm rogue ScreenConnect clients are self-propagating via a four-stage VBScript chain to newly connected endpoints, and ConnectWise has no patch yet.
opportunities.angle: Technical walkthrough of the infection chain plus a 'if you run ScreenConnect, do this today' checklist since there's no fix to wait for.

opportunities.title: Adobe Commerce Zero-Day Turns Online Stores Into Rust-Backdoored Web Shells Overnight
opportunities.why_now: The StyleSmuggler zero-day is being actively exploited to plant a Rust backdoor and PHP web shell on Magento/Adobe Commerce sites right now.
opportunities.angle: Breach anatomy piece — how the exploit chain works, IOC list, and a blunt 'if you sell things online on Magento, assume compromise' framing.

opportunities.title: MikroTik Routers Are Being Hijacked Over SSH With Zero Credentials Needed
opportunities.why_now: Attackers are exploiting new RouterOS flaws to take over internet-exposed MikroTik devices without authentication, a mass-exploitable edge-device story breaking this week.
opportunities.angle: Scan-and-patch service piece: explain the flaw, show how to check exposure, and use it as a broader 'edge devices are the new perimeter breach' argument.

opportunities.title: $320M Vanishes From Liquid Network — and the Thieves Say They're the Good Guys
opportunities.why_now: A fresh, massive crypto heist with an audacious 'we're white hats' justification is exactly the kind of threat-actor story that drives engagement.
opportunities.angle: Skeptical breakdown of the 'good guy hacker' claim, comparing it to past white-hat-heist rationalizations and asking what happens to the $320M next.
